title: Block says it is laying off more than 4,000 of its 10,000+ employees; XYZ jumps 19%+ in extended trading (Annie Palmer/CNBC)
summary: Annie Palmer / CNBC: Block says it is laying off more than 4,000 of its 10,000+ employees; XYZ jumps 19%+ in extended trading — Block said Thursday it's laying off more than 4,000 employees, or about half of its headcount. The stock skyrocketed more than 24% in extended trading.
